daily.today_energy: The cosmic vibes are soft but potent today, Pisces. You're tuning into frequencies others can't hear—trust those intuitive whispers. This is your moment to let your weird shine.
daily.love: Someone's been thinking about you more than you realize. Whether you're single or coupled up, the universe is nudging connection into focus. Lead with authenticity, not strategy.
daily.career: Your ideas have more weight than usual right now. Don't dim your vision just because it sounds unconventional. Pitch, propose, or pivot with confidence—the timing is lowkey perfect.
daily.health: Your body's asking for slowness today. Honor rest without guilt. Movement that feels like play (not punishment) will energize you more than a brutal gym sesh ever could.

weekly.overview: Mercury's vibes are shifting your communication style this week, Pisces. You're feeling more grounded and less in your head, which is honestly refreshing. Trust the gentle nudges guiding you toward authenticity.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled or solo, there's a sweetness in the air around you. If you're taken, deep convos are flowing naturally. If you're single, don't be surprised by meaningful connections forming through unexpected places.
weekly.career: Your creative energy is on another level right now. This is the time to pitch that idea or show your work. People are more receptive to your unique perspective than you think. Lean into what makes you different.
